title: Ochigee Designer Tsukutte Pon!
native_title: 落ちゲー・デザイナー 作ってポン！
overview: Ochige Designer: Tsukutte Pon! is a game creation tool that lets the player make their own customized falling-block puzzle game. It is possible to customize the game rules, including how pieces are cleared, as well as the well size and orientation, piece and character graphics, and even the title screen. Various rule sets are available, in the style of games including Tetris, Columns, Puyo Puyo, and Panic Bomber. There are six different sample games included in the package, which demonstrate the tool's various features and configuration options.
